name: Asaf Chopurov
summary: Unbeaten 24-year-old Azerbaijani bantamweight (11-0) based in Volgograd, signed from UAE Warriors where he won and twice defended the bantamweight title. Our prospect list ranks him No. 1 and MMA Prospect Vault named him among its top 25 worldwide. A relentless pressure finisher: 10 of 11 wins inside the distance, mostly in round one.

how_they_fight.Striking: Pressure striker with fight-ending power: knocked out Reece McLaren (17-0 in ONE per reports) with a counter overhand right at 1:03 as McLaren blitzed in. His base is reportedly Jeet Kune Do and he trains under kickboxer Chingiz Allazov per UAE Warriors; Heavy and MMA Mania describe him as a Petr Yan training partner, and our data lists his team as Sambo 34.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Finishes on the mat as often as on the feet: five submissions, mostly rear-naked chokes per UAE Warriors, including Adriano Ramos in round one (our verified data has a submission; SI described it as a knockout). Ground-and-pound and back takes off scrambles. Former IMMAF junior world champion with a reported 35-1 amateur record.
how_they_fight.Defense: Never stopped or beaten. Little tape of him in deep water against UFC-level opposition; McLaren and Demarte Pena are his best names.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Fast starter and finisher: 7 of 11 wins came in round one (4 KO/TKO, 3 subs), 3 more in round three (two subs, and Pena retiring on his stool after three rounds of pressure in a five-round title fight), and only one decision (Nikita Mikhailov, RCC 2024). So he has gone 15 minutes twice and still won clearly, which suggests his pace holds; he wins early or breaks people late.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Confident to the point of brash: asked Sean Shelby for the toughest fight available and dismissed Thicknesse publicly. Shows patience in long fights (Pena) but prefers to force the finish.

patterns: First-round finisher: 7 of 11 wins in round one
Late finishes when the early one doesn't come (3 wins in round three)
Counter right hand against opponents rushing in
Rear-naked choke off scrambles and back takes
concerns: UFC debut; first fight against a UFC-level opponent
Opposition quality on the regional/UAE Warriors scene; no verified UFC stats
Team details differ across sources (Sambo 34, Allazov, Petr Yan camp)
Nationality reported differently (Azerbaijani per UAE Warriors and Heavy, Russian per Telecomasia); he competes under the Azerbaijani flag and lives in Russia
keys_to_beat: Survive the first round without exchanging recklessly
Don't rush in straight lines into his counter right
Drag him into long, close rounds and test the cage experience

news.text: Signed by the UFC and booked for his debut against Colby Thicknesse at UFC 333 in Abu Dhabi.
Says he was first offered Said Nurmagomedov before Thicknesse was named, and that he asked matchmaker Sean Shelby for the toughest available fight.
Knocked out Reece McLaren at 1:03 of round one at UAE Warriors 72 for his second title defence.
